description: This Java source file defines a Spring Shell component for managing mock light devices, including listing, adding, turning on/off, toggling, and setting light levels.

classes.name: LightDeviceShell
classes.description: Spring Shell component providing command-line controls for mock light devices

classes.name: NameValueProvider
classes.description: Inner class extending DeviceNameProvider for providing device names of MockLight devices

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists all mock light devices in a table format

methods.name: addLight
methods.description: Adds a new mock light device with an optional name

methods.name: turnOn
methods.description: Turns on a specified light device

methods.name: turnOff
methods.description: Turns off a specified light device

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the state of a specified light device

methods.name: level
methods.description: Sets the light level of a specified light device
